title: Want to lose your home? Then just involve Freemen on the Land.  Another cautionary tale.
summary: UK barrister recounts a case where several borrowers using freeman-on-the-land defences from an unqualified adviser all lost their homes.

assertions.quote: eight or nine people who've all lost their houses when they may have had decent defenses
there is a reasonable chance of me being able to pay off the areas within a reasonable period

verdicts.note: Under UK law courts can adjourn or suspend possession where arrears can be cleared in a reasonable period, and often do.
